Compared with RTMDet-tiny, they improve all four metrics on both datasets by 0.52-27.55% and consistently surpass representative distillation methods, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [213] [SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24875)
*Kewei Zhang,Zheng Chen,Haotong Qin,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPHQuant，一种面向VLM的免旋转球面权重仅量化框架，在极低比特下匹配SOTA精度并提升解码吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原生多模态VLM成为下一代基础模型核心，但其大语言主干因高内存占用和内存受限的自回归解码难以在边缘部署。权重仅训练后量化是实用方案，但推向极低比特仍困难：免旋转方法在2-3比特受异常值影响，旋转方法虽提升精度却带来额外运行时开销。

Method: SPHQuant免旋转、球面权重仅量化。将每个8D权重向量分解为坐标符号、半径与正单位方向，把异常值幅度隔离到半径，方向保持有界且统计规整；对半径分配额外精度以缓解异常值导致的精度下降。采用紧凑正方向码本，并通过角参数化微调码本条目以保持单位球约束。设计硬件友好的GEMV内核，使方向码本足够小以放入共享内存查找，并高效打包径向比特。

Result: 实验表明SPHQuant匹配最先进极低比特量化方法性能，同时在RTX A6000上解码吞吐较QTIP提升30.3%。

Conclusion: SPHQuant以球面分解与径向精度分配实现免旋转极低比特量化，兼顾精度与效率，代码将开源。

Abstract: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.

</details>


### [214] [Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24879)
*Xiaodan Xing,Rajat R. Rasal,Julia A. Meister,Sara Ghorayeb,Galvin Khara,Jessica Schrouff*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出specialisation框架，将预训练非因果生成模型适配为因果机制，并据此训练了放射学反事实图像生成模型RadCF。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗领域采用反事实图像生成受限于标注数据稀缺、数据集间分布偏移，以及预训练生成模型与反事实推断所需模型之间的不匹配。

Method: 提出specialisation——一种数据与参数高效的框架，用于在分布偏移下将预训练非因果生成模型适配为因果机制；基于该框架，采用潜在流匹配（latent flow matching）训练放射学反事实生成模型RadCF。

Result: 在三个胸片数据集上验证，涵盖不同分布偏移、数据量和反事实问题，并涉及具有挑战性的高度局部化干预。结果显示RadCF和specialisation在数据与参数高效的同时提升了反事实合理性，且生成的反事实可用于检测和缓解下游医疗分类器中的捷径学习。

Conclusion: specialisation与RadCF在数据与参数高效的前提下改善了反事实合理性，并能辅助识别和缓解下游医疗分类器的捷径学习，代码已开源。

Abstract: Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios. Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier. Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/.

</details>


### [215] [SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24894)
*Ali Kerem Bozkurt,Baris Cem Bakay,Ibrahim Kulac,Cigdem Gunduz-Demir,Erkut Erdem,Aykut Erdem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SLICEChat是一种整合渐进式token剪枝与Mamba-Transformer混合编码器的幻灯片级多模态大模型，实现高效且准确的全切片病理图像推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全切片病理图像含十亿像素级视觉内容，现有方法处理数千patch token且仅在编码后才压缩，导致多模态注意力计算开销巨大，存在严重的可扩展性挑战。

Method: 在混合Mamba-Transformer幻灯片编码器中集成渐进式token剪枝：Mamba层实现高效长程传播，Transformer层在序列逐步缩短时保持全局交互；阶段间采用语言监督、区域感知剪枝，按受控保留率移除空间连贯的低效用区域，在多模态融合前生成紧凑的幻灯片表示。

Result: 在SlideBench VQA上，TCGA队列达79.84%准确率，BCNB队列达59.09%，优于以往幻灯片级病理MLLM；WSI-Bench整体指标最高，同时内存占用具竞争力，推理延迟在评估模型中表现良好。

Conclusion: SLICEChat证明了在十亿像素全切片病理图像上实现准确且计算高效的多模态推理的可行性。

Abstract: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.

</details>


### [216] [PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24919)
*Yongsheng Yu,Wei Xiong,Yichen Sheng,Shiqiu Liu,Jiebo Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PixelDiT2，一种端到端像素空间扩散模型，通过引入冻结的预训练视觉基础模型提供显式的逐 patch 表示引导（representation grounding），将表示学习与像素生成解耦，从而在不使用自编码器或潜空间重建瓶颈的情况下加速收敛并提升图像质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽然已缩小与潜空间扩散在图像质量上的差距，但收敛更慢、最终质量仍落后。作者认为关键原因在于缺乏显式的表示先验：潜空间扩散在紧凑且结构化的潜空间中去噪，而像素扩散需要从原始 RGB 空间同时学习适合去噪的表示和像素生成，负担过重。

Method: 提出 PixelDiT2，端到端像素空间扩散模型，将表示学习与像素生成解耦，且不引入自编码器或潜空间重建瓶颈。核心方法是 representation grounding：使用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型，在整个去噪过程中提供显式的逐 patch 表示引导，使像素扩散 Transformer 能更专注于像素生成。

Result: 在 ImageNet-256x256 上，PixelDiT2 经 600 个 epoch 训练达到 FID 1.46；在 512x512 分辨率下，经 680 个 epoch 训练达到 FID 1.48。

Conclusion: 通过引入冻结视觉基础模型提供的显式表示引导，PixelDiT2 有效缓解了像素空间扩散缺乏表示先验的问题，在无需自编码器或潜空间重建瓶颈的前提下取得具有竞争力的 FID，表明表示接地是提升像素扩散收敛速度与生成质量的有效途径。

Abstract: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs.

</details>


### [217] [Anatomy-Decomposed Chest Computed Tomography (CT) Projections as Scalable Supervision for Bone Suppression in Chest Radiographs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24937)
*Mrunmay Angaitkar,Piyush Kumar,Aarjav Satia,Pranav Rao,Ashish Mittal,Manoj Tadepalli,Preetham Putha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于数字重建放射影像（DRR）的框架，利用胸部CT生成成对监督数据，实现胸片中的骨骼与肺部组件抑制，无需真实配对训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胸片中骨骼重叠会掩盖异常，而监督式骨骼抑制所需的成对训练数据极其稀缺，因此需要一种无需真实配对数据的组件抑制方法。

Method: 提出一种新颖的骨骼分割算法，将CT分解为骨骼、非肺软组织与肺三种组件并分别投影；通过加权组合生成像素配准、各组件之和精确等于完整DRR的合成胸片。模型预测目标组件并通过相减恢复剩余部分；进一步利用真实胸片上的输出作为目标域，进行非配对、组件级的DRR翻译，以缩小外观差异并保留解剖细节。

Result: 在多个公开数据集上的下游检测实验表明骨骼抑制具有实用价值，增益集中在骨骼重叠显著的异常上。与开源DRR引擎相比，未修改的DRR在真实感和标签相关解剖保留上相当，而翻译后的DRR在FID、肺野清晰度及与源CT解剖一致性上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 该框架通过DRR生成的配对监督数据有效实现骨骼/肺部组件抑制，并可迁移至真实胸片，提升重叠异常检测性能；翻译后的DRR在多项指标上优于对比方法。模型与推理代码、投影数据均已开源。

Abstract: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression; Translated projections: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

</details>


### [218] [GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24981)
*Jiahao Lu,Minghao Yin,Wenbo Hu,Hengyu Liu,Wang Zhao,Sai-Kit Yeung,Ying Shan,Yuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何原生自编码器 GAE，将几何基础模型特征重参数化为紧凑隐空间，使生成器在保持外观质量的同时显著提升 3D 一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成器能输出逼真画面，却难以维持一致的 3D 场景。作者认为根本原因不只是建模问题，更是表征问题：生成器通常演化以外观为中心的隐变量，而感知模型在语义丰富、编码跨视角结构的空间中恢复几何。因此需要一种能同时服务感知与生成的共享隐空间。

Method: 提出几何原生自编码器（GAE），将几何基础模型的特征重参数化为紧凑隐空间。该隐变量可联合解码为外观、深度、相机和点图。在此状态上，使用标准条件流（conditional flow）支持多种生成任务。实验在固定生成器与训练协议的条件下，对比替换隐变量的效果。

Result: 在 RealEstate10K 与 DL3DV 上，FVD 分别下降 12.7% 与 23.1%；在 RealEstate10K 上相机轨迹误差减半。视觉质量和独立测量的 3D 一致性均得到提升。

Conclusion: 隐空间是几何一致生成的核心，可充当感知与生成之间的共享接口，说明几何一致性生成不仅是建模问题，更是表征问题。

Abstract: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.

</details>


### [219] [WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24984)
*Wangbo Yu,Kunhao Liu,Wenbo Hu,Shenghai Yuan,Chaoran Feng,Haiyang Zhou,Yukun Huang,Yiran Wang,Wang Zhao,Yingmin Luo,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WorldCrafter 提出一种可被相机查询的隐式 3D 感知记忆机制，用于视频世界模型，从而在长时间、跨视角的场景探索中保持与历史观测的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型虽支持动态环境的交互式探索，但在长时域和跨视角下难以持续尊重先前的观测，导致一致性不足。

Method: 核心思想是让请求的视角决定多视角证据如何压缩进视频生成器有限的 token 预算中。与视频生成器联合训练一个记忆编码器和姿态条件化的读出模块，在去噪前将历史观测整合为固定数量的目标视角特定 token，且无需显式的基于深度的对应关系。该方法将记忆与近期时间上下文结合，并采用少步蒸馏，实现从单张图像或文本提示出发的流式场景探索。

Result: 在静态和动态场景的实验表明，该方法在长时域一致性和相机控制精度上大幅提升，同时在分钟级探索中保持了视觉质量。

Conclusion: WorldCrafter 通过视角驱动的隐式 3D 感知记忆，有效提升了视频世界模型的长期一致性与相机可控性，支持分钟级的流式场景探索。

Abstract: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

</details>


### [220] [VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24997)
*Binxu Li,Haoyi Duan,Yuhui Zhang,Yaohui Zhang,Zihao Lin,Kaituo Feng,Suozhi Huang,Xiangyi Li,Yu Li,Chunyuan Li,Shilong Liu,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VideoGen-Agent，一个通过多任务智能体强化学习训练的多模态智能体，可调用外部工具完成视频生成；并构建 VABench 基准，性能显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成高保真、时序连贯的视频，但难以满足需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件的提示需求，需要借助外部工具增强。

Method: 训练一个共享策略，在多轮交互中协调增强、生成与验证工具，依据提示和中间观察做决策；使用涵盖六类任务的类别平衡数据集，先通过教师生成轨迹进行监督微调建立工具使用行为，再用强化学习细化；采用类别感知混合奖励，评估工具调用有效性、任务适配的工具使用及生成视频质量。

Result: 在 VABench（600 条提示，覆盖程序性知识、单/多实体身份保持、物理一致性、场景构图和多镜头时序结构）上，相比基础文生视频模型提升 19.1 分（56.5→75.6）；升级生成工具后无需额外智能体训练即可达到 86.1 分；人类评估者在 84.3% 的对比中更偏好升级配置。

Conclusion: 结果表明跨视频生成任务学习工具使用是有效的，且训练好的智能体能受益于后续生成工具的进步。

Abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools.

</details>


### [221] [GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.25001)
*Yiran Wang,Xingyilang Yin,Junfu Pu,Guangzhi Wang,Kaifeng Li,Mingyu Ouyang,Huiqiang Sun,Lingen Li,Cheng Cheng,Wangbo Yu,Honghao Chen,Xiaodong Cun,Chi-Man Pun,Zhiguo Cao,Ying Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GameHorizon统一数据与评测套件，用于在不同时间尺度上衡量AI模型的游戏操作能力，涵盖标注流水线、大规模AAA游戏数据集和离线/在线基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集与基准要么覆盖游戏范围窄、要么缺乏语言指令、要么依赖高方差的在线推演，难以系统评估AI模型在多时间尺度上的游戏能力，因此需要一个统一的数据与评测方案。

Method: GameHorizon Suite包含三部分：GameHorizon-Annotator（可扩展的自动化多时间尺度指令标注流水线）；基于该流水线构建的GameHorizon-Data（首个大规模AAA游戏数据集，含5000小时、21款游戏、100名人类专家的时序对齐视频、玩家操作与多时间尺度指令）；GameHorizon-Bench（可复现的离线测试与逐步在线测试，离线含三类主任务及诊断变体，在线用于验证离线分数并定位长程操作中的失败步骤）。

Result: 基于该套件对47个模型进行了超100万次调用评测，揭示了清晰的任务难度层级以及模型能力间的显著差异。

Conclusion: 该工作为跨时间尺度、跨模型族的游戏能力评估提供了标准化标尺，并将公开数据集、标注工具与基准以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [222] [Causal Localization of the Refusal Direction in Audio Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22260)
*Leonardo Haw-Yang Foo,Hung-yi Lee*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 通过因果干预定位音频大模型拒绝行为的来源，发现拒绝余量主要依赖中后层语言模型（LM）而非音频接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频大模型（LALM）将语音前端接入已对齐安全的文本语言模型。当模型拒绝有害语音请求时，该拒绝是由前端承载还是继承自文本LM尚不明确，这关系到安全审计的对象与方式。

Method: 在音频-LM接口及各LM残差层拟合区分有害与良性提示的方向，消融该成分，测量首token拒绝余量的变化。评估5个LALM（3个骨干家族，3个通过安全基线门槛），其中4个在留出类别偏移下测试；并做编码器清零、线性可解码性、跨模型方向迁移等干预。

Result: 最大效应出现在LM中后层，接口方向消融几乎无影响。Qwen2.5-Omni上消融L16方向使余量变化-7.10，而投影器仅-0.013；清零编码器输出变化-4.7。早期层对比度线性可解码但单层消融影响小，且仅用LM骨干拟合的方向可迁移到完整音频模型。

Conclusion: 拒绝余量主要继承自文本LM而非音频前端；该方向应解读为与拒绝相关而非特异于有害性；干预定位的是依赖位置而非计算位置，移动余量不总改变生成内容。安全审计应使用干预而非仅依赖探针，并同时检查继承的文本LM与音频接口。

Abstract: A large audio language model (LALM) attaches a speech front end to a text language model (LM) that is already safety-aligned. When such a model refuses a harmful spoken request, is the refusal carried by the front end, or inherited from the text LM? We test this with causal interventions. At each model's audio-to-LM interface and at tested LM residual layers, we fit a direction separating harmful from benign prompts, ablate its component, and measure the resulting change in the model's first-token refusal margin. Four of the five models are evaluated under held-out category shift. Across five LALMs spanning three backbone families, with three models passing a baseline safety gate, the largest tested effects occur in a mid-to-late LM band, while ablations of the tested interface directions have little effect. On Qwen2.5-Omni, ablating the L16 direction changes the margin by -7.10, versus -0.013 at the projector. The audio pathway is still in use: zeroing the encoder output changes the margin by -4.7. In the same model, the contrast is linearly decodable at an early layer where single-layer ablation has little effect, and a direction fitted on the LM backbone alone transfers to the full audio model. Because harmful and benign prompts also differ in form, we interpret the direction as refusal-linked rather than harmfulness-specific. These interventions localize dependence of the refusal margin, not where refusal is computed. Moving the margin also does not always change what the model writes. Safety audits of these models should use interventions rather than rely on probes alone, and should examine the inherited text LM alongside the audio interface.

</details>


### [223] [Hi-Singers: A Comprehensive High-Quality Dataset for Expressive Audio-Driven Singing Head Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22264)
*Yichi Zhang,Hui Zhang,Guanjun Liu,Yuefeng Zou,Fengzhao Sun,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出Hi-Singers，首个面向歌唱头部合成的大规模高质量自然场景视频数据集，包含29,608个视频片段、约170小时，并配套建立跨语言与音乐风格的评测基准，实验证明其显著提升多种架构的生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动数字人生成模型在说话头部合成上已实现照片级真实感，但迁移到歌唱头部合成时面临显著的领域鸿沟：歌唱需要更夸张的表情、更生动的下颌张合以及精确的节奏同步。当前模型主要在语音数据集上训练，常出现"节奏漂移"和动态受限的问题，缺乏专门的高质量歌唱数据支撑。

Method: 构建Hi-Singers数据集，采用严格的自动化与人工双重过滤流程，确保主题一致性、高分辨率渲染和稳定运动；数据规模为29,608个视频片段、约170小时。同时建立覆盖语言与音乐风格均衡的专用评测基准，并在3D系数与扩散等多样性架构上进行广泛实验验证。

Result: 实验表明Hi-Singers在所有维度上均持续且显著地提升性能：生成结果具备更优的视觉真实感、更强的唇音同步一致性以及更精确的节奏动态，有效弥合了领域鸿沟，为歌唱合成任务树立了新的性能标准。

Conclusion: Hi-Singers作为首个面向歌唱头部合成的大规模高质量数据集，通过严谨的数据构建与评测设计，证明了数据层面的领域适配对歌唱合成的重要性，推动该任务达到新的性能水平，数据集已公开。

Abstract: State-of-the-art models for audio-driven digital human generation have achieved photo-realistic results in talking-head synthesis. However, extending these models to singing-head synthesis remains challenging due to a significant Domain Gap: singing requires more exaggerated expressions, vivid jaw openings, and precise rhythmic synchronization. Current models, primarily trained on speech datasets, often struggle with "rhythmic drift" and constrained dynamics. To address this, we introduce Hi-Singers, the first large-scale, high-quality, in-the-wild video dataset specifically tailored for singing head synthesis. Hi-Singers undergoes a rigorous automated and manual filtering pipeline, ensuring strict thematic adherence, high-resolution rendering, and stable motion, resulting in 29,608 video segments totaling approximately 170 hours. We further establish a dedicated evaluation benchmark balanced across linguistic and musical styles. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures, including 3D-coefficient and diffusion-based models, demonstrate that Hi-Singers consistently and significantly improves performance across all dimensions. Specifically, it enables models to achieve superior visual realism, enhanced lip-sync consistency, and more precise rhythmic dynamics, effectively bridging the domain gap and setting a new performance standard for the singing synthesis task. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers

</details>


### [224] [Visual Graph Reasoning via Knowledge Compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22327)
*Rongzheng Wang,Zhe Wang,Ke Qin,Rongwei Wang,Muquan Li,Yizhuo Ma,Yihong Huang,Jielei Wang,Shuang Liang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出VGCompiler，一种以知识编译为核心的视觉图推理范式，通过表示编译器和操作编译器从图像中恢复显式图表示并生成可执行图操作，在多个基准和真实场景中显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉图推理要求直接从图图像中回答图论问题，图拓扑与状态以视觉形式而非符号形式呈现。现有视觉语言模型方法在简单视觉图问题上仍失败，根本原因在于它们侧重最终答案监督，而忽视了对保持图拓扑与状态的显式图表示的中间恢复。

Method: 提出VGCompiler，以知识编译为中心的视觉图推理范式，包含两个编译器：表示编译器从视觉输入中恢复结构保持的中间图表示；操作编译器将恢复图状态下的查询意图编译为可执行的图操作。基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建，使用分层奖励强化学习训练，奖励涵盖可执行性、编译图有效性、表示质量与操作质量；并利用冻结观察器将图与问题条件总结为轻量签名，实现归档检索与代码复用。

Result: 在GVLQA、VisionGraph和VGCURE三个基准上，基于8B骨干的Qwen-VGCompiler分别超越最强闭源VLM基线28.9%、超越最强代码基线23.7%，同时保持高效率。在地铁路由、物流配送和网络故障评估三个真实领域中也表现良好，可跨异构视觉图和领域任务泛化。

Conclusion: VGCompiler表明，将视觉图推理重构为以显式图表示恢复与操作编译为中心的编译过程，能有效克服现有VLM在视觉图推理上的局限，并在基准与真实应用中兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Visual graph reasoning requires answering graph-theoretic questions directly from graph images, where graph topology and state are conveyed visually rather than given in symbolic form. Despite recent progress of vision-language models (VLMs), current approaches to visual graph reasoning still fail on simple visual graph problems. This reveals a fundamental limitation of existing approaches: they prioritize final-answer supervision over the intermediate recovery of an explicit graph representation that preserves graph topology and state from visual input. To address this limitation, we propose VGCompiler, a compilation-centric paradigm for visual graph reasoning via knowledge compilation. VGCompiler organizes reasoning around two compilers: a representation compiler that recovers a structure-preserving intermediate graph representation from visual input, and an operation compiler that compiles query intent under the recovered graph state into an executable graph operation. Specifically, we build VGCompiler on Qwen3-VL-8B and train it with reinforcement learning guided by a layered reward over executability, compiled graph validity, representation quality, and operation quality. VGCompiler uses a frozen observer to summarize graph and question conditions into lightweight signatures, enabling archive retrieval and code reuse across similar regimes. Experiments on three benchmarks GVLQA, VisionGraph, and VGCURE, show that Qwen-VGCompiler, built on an 8B backbone, surpasses the strongest closed-source VLM baseline by 28.9% and the strongest code-based baseline by 23.7%, while maintaining high efficiency. We further evaluate VGCompiler on three real-world domains, including metro routing, logistics delivery, and network fault assessment, where it generalizes across heterogeneous visual graphs and domain-grounded tasks.

</details>


### [225] [If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23376)
*Yi Xu,Cheng Chen,Wenzhuo Lei*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出OV-OrthKD可靠性感知非对称蒸馏框架，通过监督放置解决开放词汇音视频事件定位问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放词汇音视频事件定位任务中，不同监督来源（视觉教师与音频教师）的时间边界可靠性存在差异，需要明确哪些教师信号可主导定位决策、哪些应仅作辅助。

Method: OV-OrthKD框架：视觉特征迁移塑造决策对齐表示，音频特征迁移丰富辅助子空间，文本原型锚定可见/不可见类别语义，正交损失限制两个教师投影的方向重叠；学生推理时通过查询感知融合使用双模态，训练默认让音频教师监督不参与片段logit路径。

Result: 在OV-AVEBench上取得0.816片段AP，F1@0.5较官方微调基线整体提升2.7点，不可见类别提升3.4点；路径分配、角色互换、损坏和迁移分析均支持监督放置为任务特定设计轴。

Conclusion: 监督放置是OV-AVEL中任务特定的关键设计轴，可靠性感知的非对称蒸馏可有效提升定位性能。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) grounds a text-queried event in time from video, audio, and language. The supervision sources available to this task can differ in temporal-boundary reliability: on OV-AVEBench, our configured visual teacher gives more reliable boundary cues than the configured audio teacher, although the latter is a strong pretrained audio model and remains semantically informative. This is a setting-specific diagnostic rather than a universal ranking of vision and audio. We formulate the resulting challenge as supervision placement: which teacher signals may shape the localization decision, and which should remain auxiliary. Based on this view, we propose OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric distillation framework. Visual feature transfer shapes a decision-aligned representation, audio feature transfer enriches a complementary auxiliary subspace, a text prototype anchors seen/unseen category semantics, and an orthogonality loss limits directional overlap between the two teacher-specific projections. The student continues to use both modalities through query-aware fusion at inference, while the default training recipe keeps audio-teacher supervision off the segment-logit path. On OV-AVEBench, OV-OrthKD achieves 0.816 segment AP and improves F1@0.5 over the official fine-tuning baseline by 2.7 points overall and 3.4 points on unseen categories. Path-assignment, role-swap, corruption, and transfer analyses consistently support supervision placement as a task-specific design axis for OV-AVEL.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [226] [PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22106)
*Peiran Wang,Anqi Wang,Jiaying Zhao,Huiwen Yang,Zhenyu Ming,Rongqian Wang,Yiwu Yao,Kun Tian,Xin Yao,Gong Zhang,Fan Yang,Zhongyi Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRQuant提出一种免训练、低开销的低比特量化框架，通过通道重排与静态权重残差补偿，消除在线gather开销，降低量化误差并提升下游精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性层低比特量化的精度主要受少量离群值影响。现有方法（平滑、旋转、残差补偿等）虽能缓解，但往往给权重引入新的精度瓶颈，且多数为在线实现，执行开销大。

Method: 在AWQ风格缩放后，识别对权重量化误差贡献最大的输入通道，将其置换为连续尾部块，并离线构建对应的残差权重子张量。推理时该连续结构使激活端无需昂贵的在线gather操作，将分散的残差补偿转为规则的尾部增强GEMM。

Result: 有效降低down-projection重建误差。消融显示平滑与残差补偿是数值提升的主要来源，置换提供稳定的边际数值收益并带来硬件友好的连续布局。在五个下游基准上平均精度优于MXFP4及所评估的PTQ基线，在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507与Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507上分别较MXFP4提升1.24与0.55。

Conclusion: PRQuant是一种免训练、低开销的量化框架，结合通道重排与静态权重侧残差补偿，在降低延迟的同时提升低比特量化精度，整体优于MXFP4及所评估的PTQ基线。

Abstract: Accuracy of Low-bit quantization of linear layers is often dominated by a small number of outliers. Although existing methods, such as smoothing, rotation, or residual-based approaches, may mitigate this problem, they often introduce new accuracy bottlenecks to weights. Besides, most of these techniques are implemented as online approaches, which can result in heavy execution overheads. To address the afore-mentioned issues, We propose PRQuant (Permutation Residual Quantization), a training-free and low-overhead framework that combines channel reorganization with static weight-side residual compensation. After AWQ-style scaling, PRQuant identifies the input channels that contribute most to weight quantization error, permutes them into contiguous tail blocks, and constructs their residual weight sub-tensors offline. During inference, this contiguous structure enables the activation side to use tail blocks seamlessly without the expensive online gathering operation, and turns scattered residual compensation into a regular tail-augmented GEMM, substantially reducing latency. Experiments demonstrate that PRQuant effectively reduces down-projection reconstruction error. Ablation studies confirm that smoothing and residual compensation are the primary drivers of numerical improvement, while permutation provides a consistent marginal numerical benefit and, more importantly, enables a hardware-friendly contiguous layout that eliminates dynamic gathering overhead. Overall, PRQuant outperforms default MXFP4 and the evaluated PTQ baselines in average accuracy across five downstream benchmarks, improving over MXFP4 by 1.24 and 0.55 on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, respectively.

</details>


### [227] [Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22107)
*Huizi Cui,Zongbo Han,Chenggong Ding,Naichuan Xiao,Jialong Yang,Jingdong Chen,Guangyu Wang,Qinghua Hu,Changqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于大规模合成多模态数据集训练的广义多模态基础模型，可处理任意模态组合与预测任务，在18个真实数据集上无需任务特定适配即达到专业模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合模型部署后只能处理预定义模态（如视觉、文本、音频）和单一任务，难以快速适应新的下游应用，因此需要一种适用于任意模态组合和任意预测任务的通用多模态融合模型。

Method: 作者认为统一多模态融合模型不应依赖特定模态，而应编码可迁移的多模态关联模式。为此提出一种简单有效的学习范式：在大规模合成多模态数据集上训练，这些数据集具有多样的因果结构，形式化刻画真实世界多模态数据的生成过程。基于该框架提出广义多模态基础模型（generalized multimodal foundation model），通过构建具有多样关联模式的大规模合成多模态数据集，在训练中编码可迁移的多模态关联，并在推理时通过上下文示例激活适当关联。

Result: 在涵盖12种模态和11种预测任务的18个真实世界数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该模型无需任务特定适配即可达到与专业模型相当的性能。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了基于合成数据训练的统一多模态基础模型在任意模态组合和预测任务上的通用性与竞争力，为广义多模态学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Making prediction with multimodal data is widely used in diverse scenarios. Existing multimodal fusion models, once deployed, can only handle predefined modalities (e.g., vision, text and audio) and single tasks, making it difficult to quickly adapt to new downstream applications. Therefore, a natural yet rather aggressive question arises, whether there exists a general multimodal fusion model that can be applied to arbitrary modality combinations and arbitrary prediction tasks. We argue that a unified multimodal fusion model should not depend on specific modalities and instead encode transferable patterns of multimodal correlation. To this end, we propose a simple and effective learning paradigm based on training over the generation of large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse causal structures that formally characterize the generative processes of multimodal data in real world. Building on this framework, we propose the generalized multimodal foundation model, a unified foundation model for generalized multimodal learning. By constructing large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse correlation patterns, our model encodes transferable multimodal correlations during training and activates appropriate associations through in-context examples during inference. Extensive experiments on 18 real-world datasets spanning 12 modalities and 11 prediction tasks demonstrate that our model achieves competitive performance with specialized models without task-specific adaptation.

</details>


### [228] [Correcting Learning-based Perception for Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22108)
*Yan Miao,Hussein Darir,Sayan Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种两步式运行时感知纠正策略，用于修正基于机器学习的状态估计，并验证其在视觉自适应巡航控制器中的安全性与低保守性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于学习的感知在自主系统中很重要，但ML感知的失效边界难以刻画，错误感知会导致下游控制不安全或过于保守。因此需要一种既能保证安全、又不过度保守的感知纠正方法。

Method: 采用两步策略：第一步离线计算，利用感知契约的原像来刻画ML模块状态估计产生的不确定性；第二步在运行时使用风险启发式，从不确定估计中选择特定状态来驱动控制决策。

Result: 在不同天气与道路场景下对多种基于视觉的ACC模块进行仿真评估。在45个使用Yolo和LaneNet导致安全违规的ACC场景中，73%的场景通过运行时感知纠正保持了安全；27%无法恢复，原因是感知契约原像的构造不完全符合要求。同时纠正策略并不过度保守，平均仅增加2.8%的完成时间，且干预程度轻微。

Conclusion: 该运行时感知纠正策略能有效提升ML感知控制的运行安全性，并在大多数情况下以很小的性能代价实现安全恢复，但其有效性依赖感知契约原像构造的正确性。

Abstract: Learning-enabled perception is important in many autonomous systems. Unlike traditional sensors, the boundary where ML perception does or does not work is poorly characterized. Incorrect perception can lead to unsafe or overtly conservative downstream control actions. In this paper, we propose a two-step strategy for correcting ML-based state estimation. First, an offline computation is used to characterize the uncertainties resulting from the ML module's state estimation, using preimages of perception contracts. Second, at runtime, a risk heuristic is used to choose particular states from the uncertain estimates to drive the control decisions. We perform extensive simulation-based evaluation of this runtime perception correction strategy on different vision-based adaptive cruise controllers (ACC modules), in different weather conditions, and road scenarios. Out of 45 ACC scenarios where the original perception-based control system using Yolo and LaneNet led to safety violations, in 73% of the scenarios, our runtime perception correction preserved safety; our method wouldn't be able to recover 27% of the scenarios where the construction of the preimages of perception contracts is not fully conformant. Further, our runtime perception correction strategy is not overly conservative---on the average only a 2.8% increase in completion time is experienced in the corrected scenarios, with mild interventions.

</details>


### [229] [A Shared Learning Rate Is Not a Neutral Control in Selective On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22109)
*Chencheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 选择性on-policy蒸馏中，选择器比较所用的共享学习率并非中性控制：不同选择器对学习率高度敏感，导致比较结论随速率漂移，作者称之为"选择器-速率纠缠"，建议报告arm×rate矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献在比较不同token选择器时，都使用同一个固定学习率，认为这样做是"中性"的公平控制。作者要证明这一假设不成立：选择本身会与学习率发生纠缠，使选择器之间的比较结论依赖于这个被当作背景的速率参数。

Method: 在GSM8K上做LoRA训练（Qwen2.5-1.5B学生、7B教师），扫描8×学习率网格，比较dense监督与多种选择性监督（随机5%子集、total-variation选择器、teachability选择器）。追踪AdamW更新幅度与梯度范数以定位成因。另做预注册的frozen-scoring消融（用初始学生打分、12个种子）区分选择反馈循环与步长的作用。补充全量微调（1e-6到1e-5）及MATH-500上的验证。

Result: 速率网格上dense监督统计上平坦（波动1.8pp，p=0.26），而所有选择性方案随速率变化：随机5%为5.4pp，total-variation为6.7pp，teachability高达17.7pp。dense对选择性的判定在lr=1e-4时为10.1pp，lr=5e-5时降至5.1pp，相差2.0倍；六个成对显著性判定中有两个在相邻速率间翻转而无排名变化。AdamW更新幅度与速率吻合在2.2%以内，尽管各臂梯度范数差15.5倍，说明根源在选择而非步长。frozen-scoring消融显示实时打分额外增加3.79±1.69pp速率敏感性（p=0.035），但冻结臂仍显著纠缠（p=0.015）。全量微调下dense自身波动19.8pp、选择性49.5pp，判定从+3.6pp（不显著）到+34pp（p=0.005）。MATH-500上LoRA未复现该速率依赖，但选择性训练约10pp的代价仍存在。

Conclusion: 选择器与学习率存在纠缠，其根源是选择过程本身而非步长，反馈循环会加剧而非导致该现象。因此共享单一学习率的比较协议不可靠，应将每个选择器在完整速率网格上评估、报告arm×rate矩阵作为选择器比较的前提条件；同时选择性训练的约10pp代价在MATH-500上被证实。

Abstract: Selective on-policy distillation trains a student only at the token positions a selector scores highest, and the literature compares selectors under a single shared learning rate--a control chosen to be neutral. We show it is not. Under LoRA on GSM8K (Qwen2.5-1.5B student, 7B teacher), across an 8x learning-rate grid, dense supervision is statistically flat (swing 1.8 pp, p=0.26) while every selective arm moves with the rate: 5.4 pp for a random 5% subset, 6.7 pp for a total-variation selector, up to 17.7 pp for a teachability selector. Consequently the dense-versus-selective verdict reads 10.1 pp at lr=1e-4 but 5.1 pp at 5e-5--a 2.0x difference decided by a parameter the protocol treats as scenery--and two of six pairwise significance calls between selectors flip between adjacent rates without any rank inversion. We call this selector-rate entanglement and trace it to selection itself rather than step size: AdamW update magnitudes track the rate to within 2.2% despite 15.5x gradient-norm differences across arms. A preregistered frozen-scoring ablation (selection scored by the initial student; criterion, budget, and on-policy rollouts unchanged; 12 seeds per cell) shows live scoring adds 3.79+/-1.69 pp of rate sensitivity (p=0.035) while the frozen arm remains significantly entangled (p=0.015): the feedback loop aggravates the phenomenon rather than causing it. Under full fine-tuning at the rates this literature actually uses (1e-6 to 1e-5) the pattern grows: dense itself swings 19.8 pp, the selective arm 49.5 pp, and the verdict ranges from a non-significant +3.6 pp at the published operating point to +34 pp (p=0.005) one notch hotter. On MATH-500 the rate dependence does not reproduce under LoRA, scoping that result, while the ~10 pp cost of selective training does. We prescribe reporting the arm x rate matrix, not a shared-rate column, as a precondition for selector comparisons.

</details>


### [230] [Toward Fairness in Machine Learning Models for Predicting Treatment Retention and Premature Discontinuation in Medication for Opioid Use Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22113)
*Tongnian Wang,Carolina Vivas-Valencia,Cici Bauer,Yanmin Gong,Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo,Yuanxiong Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了预测阿片类使用障碍药物治疗（MOUD）留存与提前中断的机器学习模型的算法公平性，并检验偏差缓解技术的效果。结果显示，即使整体性能可接受，模型在不同患者亚组间仍存在性能差距，偏差缓解可缩小但无法完全消除差距，且存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOUD治疗的留存率和完成率长期偏低，促使研究者使用机器学习模型预测留存并识别提前中断风险的患者。然而，这些模型在不同患者群体间的公平性尚未得到充分探讨，引发其在治疗决策支持中应用的担忧。

Method: 使用横断面治疗事件数据集-出院数据（TEDS-D），涵盖2015至2019年美国出院个体的治疗事件，针对接受门诊MOUD的个体训练四个机器学习模型，预测提前治疗中断及留存超过180天。在按种族、族裔、年龄和性别定义的患者亚组中评估整体性能与亚组错误率，辅以模型解释分析，并评估偏差缓解技术对公平性与预测性能的影响。

Result: 即使整体预测性能看似可接受，MOUD结果预测的机器学习模型仍可能表现出亚组层面的性能差距；偏差缓解技术可缩小这些差距，但无法完全消除，且伴随一定的性能权衡。

Conclusion: 研究强调了公平性感知评估与亚组性能透明报告的重要性，为MOUD治疗场景中风险分层与护理优先级排序的机器学习模型的负责任、情境敏感使用提供了实践启示。

Abstract: Persistent low retention and completion rates in medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) have driven the use of machine learning (ML) models to predict retention and identify patients at risk of premature discontinuation. However, the fairness of these models across patient populations remains largely unexplored, raising concerns about their application in treatment decision support. This study systematically assesses algorithmic fairness in ML models for predicting MOUD retention and premature discontinuation and investigates the effectiveness of bias mitigation techniques. Using the cross-sectional Treatment Episode Data Set-Discharges (TEDS-D), which includes treatment episodes for individuals in the U.S. discharged between 2015 and 2019, we trained four ML models to predict premature treatment discontinuation and retention beyond 180 days among individuals receiving outpatient MOUD. We evaluated overall performance and subgroup-level error rates across patient subgroups defined by race, ethnicity, age, and sex, complemented by model explanation analyses. We further assessed bias mitigation techniques and their effects on both fairness and predictive performance. Our findings demonstrate that ML models for MOUD outcome prediction can exhibit subgroup-level performance gaps even when overall predictive performance appears acceptable and that bias mitigation can reduce, but not fully eliminate, these gaps without trade-offs. By demonstrating the importance of fairness-aware evaluation and transparent reporting of subgroup performance, this study provides practical insights for the responsible and context-sensitive use of ML models for risk stratification and care prioritization in MOUD treatment settings.

</details>


### [231] [ZoAQ: Adaptive Zeroth-Order Querying via Query-Reuse Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22115)
*Yangyang Feng,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZoAQ是一种基于查询复用的自适应零阶优化方法，利用历史函数评估同时指导更新与查询决策，无需额外验证查询即可自适应分配查询预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化中扰动查询是主要成本。固定预算每步查询数相同，效率低；自适应控制器虽可节省查询，但往往需要额外调用预言机来验证估计器可靠性，反而抵消了收益。因此需要一种不需额外验证查询的自适应查询分配方法。

Method: ZoAQ围绕查询复用设计：不丢弃每步后的历史评估，而是让它们同时服务于下一次更新和是否继续查询的决策。通过分析估计器之间的一致性（agreement），判断当前更新是否支持下降方向，并据此引导控制器确定足够的查询预算，从而实现无需额外验证查询的自适应分配。

Result: 在合成目标上，相对固定基线在1.2M查询下减少43-48%查询；黑盒攻击中，在MNIST和CIFAR-10上分别以平均320和625次查询达到100%成功率；在四种OPT微调设置中，相对固定K=4节省43-46%前向评估，各任务准确率变化在-0.018至+0.010之间。

Conclusion: 查询复用可同时支持更新与查询决策，实现高效自适应零阶优化，在合成任务、黑盒攻击和大模型微调中均显著降低查询成本，同时保持性能。

Abstract: Zeroth-order optimization (ZOO) estimates updates from function evaluations, making perturbation queries a primary cost. Fixed budgets spend the same number of queries at every step, while adaptive controllers may offset their savings by using additional oracle calls to test estimator reliability. We introduce ZoAQ, an adaptive ZOO method built around query reuse. Rather than discarding past evaluations after each step, ZoAQ makes them useful for both the next update and the decision to query further. This enables adaptive query allocation without extra validation queries. Our analysis characterizes when this agreement identifies an update that supports descent and guides the controller to a sufficient query budget. On synthetic objectives, ZoAQ reduces queries by 43-48% relative to fixed baselines using 1.2M queries. In black-box attacks, it reaches 100% success with 320 and 625 average queries on MNIST and CIFAR-10, respectively. Across four OPT fine-tuning settings, ZoAQ saves 43-46% forward evaluations relative to fixed K=4, with accuracy changes within tasks ranging from -0.018 to +0.010.

</details>


### [232] [LE4Mob: Towards Inductive, Distance-Aware and General-Purpose Location Embedding for Human Mobility Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22117)
*Xinglei Wang,Stephen Law,Zichao Zeng,Junyuan Liu,Guangsheng Dong,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LE4Mob：一个归纳式、距离感知、由地理信息衍生的位置嵌入框架，用于移动性建模，可编码未见过位置并跨任务迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置嵌入依赖移动性观测，无法表示未见过位置，且对地理距离的保留约束较弱，限制了跨数据集与跨任务的复用。作者希望构建可复用、地理衍生、距离感知的位置表示以支撑移动性建模。

Method: LE4Mob扩展了对比式语言-位置预训练，并引入距离感知正则化目标，使嵌入空间保留空间关系。模型从地理上下文预训练，因此能编码丰富的空间语义信息，并可归纳式地为未见过位置生成嵌入；其不依赖下游移动性任务监督，因而具有迁移性。

Result: 在个体级下一位置预测与人群级通勤流量生成两类任务上，跨多个数据集和研究区域实验表明，LE4Mob优于强基线，在归纳设置以及下游模型直接依赖位置嵌入交互时优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 距离感知、地理衍生的位置表示可作为人类移动性建模的可复用基础，具备归纳能力与跨任务迁移潜力。

Abstract: Location representations provide mobility models with fundamental information about the spatial position, functional characteristics, and relationships of places. However, existing embeddings are often dependent on mobility observations, unable to represent unseen locations, and weakly constrained to retain geographic distance. This limits their reuse across datasets and mobility tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LE4Mob, an inductive, distance-aware, and geography-derived location embedding framework for mobility modelling. LE4Mob extends contrastive language-location pre-training while introducing a distance-aware regularisation objective that encourages the embedding space to preserve spatial relationships. Pre-trained from geographic context, LE4Mob can encode rich spatial-semantic information and generate embeddings for unseen locations inductively. Its independence from downstream mobility task supervision also makes it transferable across different mobility tasks. We evaluate LE4Mob on individual-level next location prediction and population-level commuter flow generation. Experiments across multiple datasets and study areas show that LE4Mob outperforms strong baselines, with particular advantages in inductive settings and when downstream models rely directly on interactions between location embeddings. These findings demonstrate the potential of distance-aware, geography-derived location representations as reusable foundations for human mobility modelling.

</details>


### [233] [Success Leaves Detours: Learning Executable Walkthroughs for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22120)
*Kaijie Chen,Chenyu Fang,Liang Yan,Bo Li,Bo Zhang,Peng Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Trace 框架，从稀疏奖励轨迹中归纳可执行的、状态条件化、可验证的 Walkthrough，用于测试时自进化智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时自进化智能体依赖复用过往经验，但稀疏奖励轨迹含失败、循环和绕路，且现有摘要常缺失执行所需的状态条件与动作依赖；延迟信用只能识别与进展相关的动作，却无法判断其是否产出后续动作所需的事实。

Method: Trace 是信用引导、依赖接地的框架：从奖励与持久状态变化检测进展锚点，传播信用以识别有价值转移，并基于跨回合成功/失败证据估计动作前置条件；再通过后向依赖切片将所需事实回溯到其生产者，抽取依赖一致的动作链，剔除无关循环与绕路；产出的 Walkthrough 编码入口条件、有序的状态—动作—效果步骤及完成/失败谓词。

Result: 在 J-TTL、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上使用三个开源 LLM 实验，Trace 一致优于八个测试时学习与记忆基线；相比最强基线，平均 AUC 提升 30.0%，Final-3 提升 40.5%，且推理 token 更少。

Conclusion: 长时程交互更受益于状态条件化的可执行程序，而非完整轨迹或抽象摘要。

Abstract: Test-time self-evolving agents improve by reusing past experience, yet sparse-reward trajectories contain failures, loops, and detours, while summaries often omit the state conditions and action dependencies needed for execution. We study executable Walkthrough induction from sparse-reward trajectories: extracting compact, state-conditioned, and verifiable procedures. Our key observation is that delayed credit identifies actions associated with progress but cannot determine whether they produce facts required by later actions. We propose Trace, a credit-guided, dependency-grounded framework that compiles noisy trajectories into executable Walkthrough Memory. It detects progress anchors from rewards and persistent state changes, propagates credit to identify valuable transitions, and estimates action prerequisites from cross-episode success and failure evidence. Backward dependency slicing then traces required facts to their producers, extracting dependency-consistent action chains while removing irrelevant loops and detours. The resulting Walkthroughs encode entry conditions, ordered state--action--effect steps, and completion and failure predicates, supporting reuse, intermediate-state resumption, and programmatic verification. Experiments on J-TTL, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three open-source LLMs show that Trace consistently outperforms eight test-time learning and memory baselines. Compared with the strongest baseline, it improves average AUC and Final-$3$ by $30.0%$ and $40.5%$, respectively, while using fewer inference tokens. These results show that long-horizon interaction benefits more from state-conditioned executable procedures than from complete trajectories or abstract summaries.

</details>


### [234] [Modelling daily activity patterns from mobile phone location data via deep representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22121)
*Xinglei Wang,Junyuan Liu,Guangsheng Dong,Zichao Zeng,Stephen Law,James Haworth,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自监督活动链编码器ACE，从无标注手机定位数据中挖掘人群活动模式，并在伦敦数据上识别出六类差异化工作日活动模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动采集的手机定位数据能提供大规模、纵向的人类移动观测，但不直接揭示活动目的；访问地点的功能特征虽提供情境信息，但在混合用途城市环境中其与活动目的的关系仍不确定。因此需要一种能够整合表示、聚类与解释的无监督活动模式挖掘方法。

Method: 将活动模式挖掘概念化为表示、聚类、解释一体化流程，并提出用于表示阶段的自监督模型ACE。ACE结合预训练城市嵌入与访问时间、停留时长，利用Transformer建模停留的序列组织，通过掩码活动建模和身份引导对比学习进行训练，无需确定性的活动目的标签。学习到的日表示被聚合并生成用户级画像，再通过时间-功能模式与普查人口统计背景进行聚类和解释。

Result: 在伦敦手机应用定位数据上应用ACE，并与三种代表性方法比较，支持识别出六个差异化的工作日活动模式组，各组具有独特的日常节奏、城市功能情境和人口统计关联。这些互补证据进一步支持构建有实证依据的活动模式人物画像。

Conclusion: ACE为从无标注手机定位数据中推导具有行为意义的人群模式提供了整体路径，整个分析流程的源代码已公开。

Abstract: Passively collected mobile phone location data provide large-scale, longitudinal observations of human mobility but do not directly reveal activity purposes. The functional characteristics of visited locations offer useful contextual information, yet their relationship with activity purpose remains uncertain, particularly in mixed-use urban environments. We conceptualise activity pattern mining as an integrated process of representation, clustering, and interpretation, and propose the Activity Chain Encoder (ACE) for the representation stage. ACE is a self-supervised model that combines pre-trained urban embeddings with visit timing and duration and uses a Transformer to model the sequential organisation of stays. It is trained using masked activity modelling and identity-guided contrastive learning without requiring deterministic activity purpose labels. Learned daily representations are aggregated into user-level profiles, clustered, and interpreted through temporal-functional patterns and Census-derived demographic context. Applied to mobile phone app location data from London and compared with three representative methods, ACE supports the identification of six differentiated weekday activity-pattern groups characterised by distinct daily rhythms, urban functional contexts, and demographic associations. These complementary forms of evidence further support the development of empirically grounded activity-pattern personas, establishing a holistic route for deriving behaviourally meaningful population patterns from unlabelled mobile phone location data. The source code for the entire analytical pipeline developed in this study is publicly available at https://github.com/xlwang233/ACE.

</details>


### [235] [Rank Portability Does Not Imply Feasibility Portability: Target-Specific Evaluation of Joint Hardware Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22122)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文对"跨设备排名可迁移即可用代理设备支持目标侧模型选择"这一假设进行压力测试，发现排名可迁移性、可行性可迁移性与目标特定决策支持是三种不同的评估对象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨设备硬件评估常假设只要架构排名能跨设备迁移，代理设备就能支持目标侧的模型选择。作者认为这一假设在联合时延-能耗可行性问题上未经验证，需要严格检验其边界失效情形。

Method: 在NAS-Bench-201上进行跨设备排名相关性与可行集重叠分析，并引入忠实的AdaProxy诊断以区分"适应能力弱"与"边界本身失效"；同时用精确有限样本分裂共形分析刻画证据瓶颈；随后在13台HW-GPT-Bench设备、10,000个GPT架构上复现该现象。

Result: NAS-Bench-201上跨设备排名相关性中等，但目标可比的可行集重叠并不完整；AdaProxy诊断显著改善时延排名，说明边界失效并非源于适应能力弱；有限单侧90%阈值至少需要9个校准观测。在GPT复现中，相对RTX3080代理，目标时延SRCC达0.951–0.996，但在匹配联合约束下代理复用违规风险高达33.3%–100%。

Conclusion: 排名可迁移性、可行性可迁移性与目标特定决策支持是彼此独立的评估对象，高排名相关性并不意味着代理设备可安全复用；跨设备评估应明确报告哪些目标环境真正支持所声称的工作点。

Abstract: Cross-device hardware evaluation often assumes that if architecture rankings transfer across devices, a proxy device can support target-side model selection. We stress-test this assumption for joint latency-energy feasibility across two public architecture families. On NAS-Bench-201, cross-device rank correlations are moderate, while target-comparable feasible-set overlap remains incomplete. A faithful AdaProxy diagnostic substantially improves latency ranking, showing that the observed boundary failures are not simply due to weak adaptation. Exact finite-sample split-conformal analysis also exposes an evidence bottleneck: a finite one-sided 90% threshold requires at least nine calibration observations. We then replicate the phenomenon on 10,000 GPT architectures across 13 HW-GPT-Bench devices. Relative to an RTX3080 proxy, target latency SRCC ranges from 0.951 to 0.996, yet proxy-reuse violation risk ranges from 33.3% to 100% under matched joint constraints. These results show that rank portability, feasibility portability, and target-specific decision support are distinct evaluation objects. Cross-device evaluations should therefore report which target environments actually support the operating point being claimed.

</details>


### [236] [StationPDE: Station-Oriented Surface PDE Learning for Multi-Station Multivariate Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22123)
*Xiao Wang,Changjian Chen,Rongwen Li,Hongwu Liu,Kun Fang,Zhuo Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出StationPDE，一种面向气象站的表面偏微分方程（PDE）学习模型，通过将离散站点观测构建为地形感知连续场，并分解其物理演化进行多站多变量天气预报，在Weather2K和MeteoNet上平均MSE降低约9.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于站点的预报模型只能学习离散站点间的统计依赖，缺乏显式物理演化；而基于PDE的气象模型虽具可解释性，却需要连续场和高空变量，这些在表面站点数据中不可得。因此需要一种能弥合二者差距的方法。

Method: 提出StationPDE：1）从离散站点观测构建地形感知的连续表面场；2）将其物理演化分解为表面风输运和高空推断，其中表面风输运显式演化可观测气象变量，高空推断用可学习水平扩散近似缺失的高空变量影响；3）并行数据驱动扩散分支捕捉互补运动模式；4）自适应路由器融合两路预测，进行站点级多变量预报。

Result: 在Weather2K和MeteoNet数据集上，StationPDE持续优于最先进基线，相比最强基线平均MSE降低约9.6%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: StationPDE成功将PDE物理演化引入离散站点表面观测预报，兼顾物理可解释性与数据驱动能力，验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-station multivariate weather forecasting aims to forecast future weather variables at multiple weather stations from historical surface observations. Existing station forecasting models learn statistical dependencies among discrete stations, but lack explicit physical evolution. Meanwhile, PDE-based weather models provide interpretable physical dynamics, yet require continuous fields and upper-air variables unavailable in surface station data. To bridge this gap, we propose StationPDE, a station-oriented surface PDE learning model. StationPDE constructs a terrain-aware continuous surface field from discrete station observations and decomposes its physical evolution into surface wind transport and upper-air inference. Surface wind transport explicitly evolves observable weather variables, while upper-air inference uses learnable horizontal diffusion to approximate the missing influence of unavailable upper-air variables. A parallel data-driven diffusion branch captures complementary motion patterns, and an adaptive router integrates the two forecasts for station-level multivariate forecasting. Experiments on Weather2K and MeteoNet show that StationPDE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MSE by about $9.6\%$ on average compared with the strongest baseline. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/hnu-vis/StationPDE.

</details>


### [237] [SolarFlowRefiner: Refinement-Aware Flow Matching for Surface Solar Radiation Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22126)
*Udbhav Srivastava,Antonita Racheal,Yiheng Chen,Runlong Yu,Xinyue Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SolarFlowRefiner，一种精确感知的流匹配框架，通过将生成与校正联合优化，实现从粗分辨率ERA5和卫星通道重建高分辨率地表太阳辐射场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率地表太阳辐射（SSR）对太阳能预报和电网运行很重要，但物理一致的重分析产品分辨率过粗，无法解析局地云引起的变化。单个ERA5格点可能同时包含日照区和云影区，缺失的高分辨率校正既空间锐利又本质模糊，单阶段预测器容易过度平滑，而事后精修会引入阶段间失配。

Method: SolarFlowRefiner包含一个条件FlowMatch生成器，先预测对升采样ERA5基线的归一化校正；精修器在当前FlowMatch输出与目标残差之间的预测条件状态上训练，从而暴露于生成器产生的结构化误差；精修目标还通过FlowMatch采样器反向传播，使生成与校正联合优化。

Result: 在按天分块的ERA5–SolarCube基准上，方法相比单独生成和事后精修均取得一致改进。

Conclusion: SolarFlowRefiner为将生成式预测器与迭代校正器耦合提供了一种通用策略。

Abstract: High-resolution surface solar radiation (SSR) is important for solar forecasting and grid operation. However, physically consistent reanalysis products are too coarse to resolve localized cloud-driven variability. In this paper, we study a multisource downscaling task that reconstructs high-resolution SolarCube SSR fields from coarse ERA5 radiative variables and co-registered satellite channels. The task is challenging because a single ERA5 grid cell may contain both sunlit and cloud-shadowed regions. As a result, the missing high-resolution correction can be spatially sharp and inherently ambiguous. One-stage predictors often oversmooth these structures. Post-hoc refinement also introduces a stage-wise mismatch: the generator is optimized independently, even though its output determines the refiner's initial state. We introduce SolarFlowRefiner, a refinement-aware flow-matching framework for SSR downscaling. A conditional FlowMatch generator first predicts a normalized correction to an upsampled ERA5 baseline. The refiner is then trained on prediction-conditioned states between the current FlowMatch output and the target residual. This exposes the refiner to the structured errors produced by the generator. The refinement objective is also backpropagated through the FlowMatch sampler, allowing generation and correction to be jointly optimized for the final reconstruction. Experiments on a day-blocked ERA5--SolarCube benchmark show consistent improvements over standalone generation and post-hoc refinement. More broadly, SolarFlowRefiner provides a general strategy for coupling generative predictors with iterative correctors.

</details>


### [238] [Helix-FNO: Spectral-Domain Operator Learning Coupled with a High-Fidelity Mechanistic Model for Fast Surrogate Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22129)
*Jiabao Zhao,Chuwei Wang,Jinxi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Helix-FNO，用教师-学生架构（32 状态机理模型 + 傅里叶神经算子）学习解算子而非单一解，实现毫秒级推理、比机理模型快三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全尺度处理过程的机理仿真模型虽是可外推的高保真描述，但运行过慢，无法支撑现代决策引擎在 5 分钟决策节拍下所需的数千次前向评估。常用替代方案（代理建模）往往只对单一配置学习单一解，难以泛化到新进水水质、控制设定或厂区布局。

Method: Helix-FNO 采用教师-学生架构：32 状态机理教师生成高保真输入场-解配对数据集，并用拉丁超立方与基于不确定性的主动学习筛选，覆盖边界与过载工况；FNO 学生在谱域学习解算子本身。文中给出算子表述、谱卷积定义、加权蒸馏损失与主动学习准则，并分析截断傅里叶展开相对于参数化解流形光滑性的逼近误差。

Result: 案例研究在精度、数据集效率与推理时延上对比了 Helix-FNO、物理信息网络和数据驱动循环代理模型，并将各方法置于速度-精度帕累托前沿。所得算子推理为毫秒级，比机理教师快三个数量级。

Conclusion: 基于算子学习的代理模型可在保持精度的情况下大幅降低推理成本，满足大规模候选筛选与在线决策支持的需求。

Abstract: Mechanistic simulation models of full-scale treatment processes remain the only trustworthy, extrapolative description of the underlying physico-chemical dynamics, yet their runtime is far too slow to support the thousands of forward evaluations that a modern decision engine requires at a 5-minute decision cadence. The standard remedy-surrogate modelling-often produces a network that learns a single solution for a single configuration, so it generalises poorly to new influent profiles, control settings or plant layouts. This paper presents Helix-FNO, a teacher-student architecture that couples a thirty-two-state mechanistic teacher with a Fourier neural operator (FNO) student. The teacher supplies a high-fidelity dataset of input-field-to-solution pairs, curated by Latin-hypercube and uncertainty-based active learning to cover the boundary and overload regimes that matter in practice; the student learns, in the spectral domain, the solution operator itself rather than any single solution, thereby moving from learning one instance to learning an entire family of equations. We give the operator formulation, the spectral convolution definition, the weighted distillation loss and the active-learning criterion, and we analyse the approximation error of a truncated Fourier expansion with respect to the smoothness of the parametric solution manifold. An illustrative study compares Helix-FNO against a physics-informed network and a data-driven recurrent surrogate on accuracy, dataset efficiency and inference latency, and places the methods on a speed-accuracy Pareto front. The resulting operator is three orders of magnitude faster than the mechanistic teacher at millisecond inference, which is precisely the capability required for massive candidate screening and online decision support.

</details>


### [239] [Hierarchical Bayesian optimization of an aircraft-based multi-agent system-of-systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22130)
*Paul Saves,Thierry Lefebvre,Nathalie Bartoli,Jasper Bussemaker,Nikolaos Kalliatakis,Nabih Naeem,Prajwal Prakasha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个分层贝叶斯优化框架，利用高斯过程元建模处理系统之系统（SoS）架构设计中的离散选择、条件依赖与异构设计变量，并在野火抑制多智能体航空系统案例中验证了其搜索效率与鲁棒性优于传统代理模型方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统之系统（SoS）的架构设计依赖高保真多物理场与多学科仿真，但这类仿真计算代价高昂且存在评估失败风险，直接优化困难。传统代理模型方法难以应对SoS问题中固有的离散架构选择、条件依赖和异构设计变量，因此需要更高效的优化框架。

Method: 提出分层贝叶斯优化框架，结合高斯过程元建模，用于处理SoS架构设计中的离散架构选择、条件依赖关系以及异构设计变量，实现有限仿真预算下的大规模、结构多样化设计空间探索。

Result: 分层建模形式相比传统代理模型方法显著提升了搜索效率与鲁棒性，能够在有限的仿真预算下探索大型且结构多样的设计空间。该方法成功应用于欧盟COLOSSUS项目中的野火抑制多智能体航空系统案例，协调异构空中平台实现互补角色。

Conclusion: 该框架为SoS架构设计与模型探索提供了可扩展的方法论，为航空、可持续出行和韧性导向系统设计提供可迁移的洞见；是分层贝叶斯优化应用于真实SoS问题的首批实践示范之一，兼具方法论与实践意义。

Abstract: Developing innovative system architectures increasingly relies on advanced modeling and optimization techniques to frame the architecting process and define the corresponding computational problems. For complex System-of-Systems (SoS), high-fidelity multiphysics and multidisciplinary simulations are essential for capturing detailed behaviors. However, their computational expense and the risk of evaluation failures make direct optimization challenging. To overcome these limitations, surrogate-based approaches, like Bayesian optimization, have emerged as effective tools for managing expensive, black-box simulation tasks. This work introduces a hierarchical Bayesian optimization framework that leverages Gaussian process meta-modeling to handle discrete architectural choices, conditional dependencies, and heterogeneous design variables inherent to SoS problems. Results show that the hierarchical formulation improves search efficiency and robustness compared to conventional surrogate-based methods, enabling the exploration of large and structurally diverse design spaces with limited simulation budgets.
  We apply the approach to an aircraft-based multi-agent system for wildfire suppression, a use case developed within the EU-funded COLOSSUS project that illustrates how SoS principles can coordinate heterogeneous aerial platforms with complementary roles, supporting both sustainable mobility and emergency response missions. Our framework provides a scalable methodology for SoS architecting and model exploration, offering transferable insights for applications in aviation, sustainable mobility, and resilience-oriented system design. By combining hierarchical representations with surrogate-based optimization, this work is among the first practical demonstrations of hierarchical Bayesian optimization applied to real-world SoS problems, advancing both methodology and practice.

</details>


### [240] [Weak Ties, Strong Signals: Efficient Training Data Detection in Diffusion LLMs via Independent Token Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22145)
*Hongyao Yu,Tianqu Zhuang,Ziyuan Xu,Hao Fang,Jiaxin Hong,Bin Chen,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的成员推断攻击（MIA）检测难题，提出用注意力导出的成对依赖代理近似条件互信息（CMI）感知的选取准则，并引入多样性促进策略，从而在有限查询预算下获得更可靠的记忆化检测信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型在去噪过程中可能泄露训练数据，但检测此类使用十分困难：dLLM 缺乏因果架构那样高效的单次概率分解，现有方法只能依赖随机掩码在有限查询预算下获得可处理的逐 token 检测信号。然而随机掩码无法控制被掩码 token 之间的依赖关系，导致近似误差掩盖了微弱的记忆化信号。作者希望从理论上刻画该误差来源，并据此设计更可靠的检测方案。

Method: 作者首先证明逐 token 近似会引入非负的结构性估计误差，并用被掩码 token 之间的累积条件互信息（CMI）进行理论刻画，说明可靠检测需要内部依赖较弱的掩码 token 集合。为避免直接估计 token 组合上的 CMI 带来的高昂代价，作者提出独立 token 采样（ITS）框架：利用注意力导出的成对依赖代理来近似 CMI 感知的选取准则，并加入多样性促进策略以提升多轮采样中的 token 覆盖度，最终聚合出受依赖诱导近似误差影响更小的逐 token 信号。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，ITS 在不同模型和数据集上均持续优于当前最优基线；在 ArXiv 数据集上 AUC 提升 0.18，同时在有限查询预算下仍保持强劲性能。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了随机掩码检测中依赖诱导的结构性误差，并证明通过弱依赖的 token 选择可以更有效地检测 dLLM 中的训练数据记忆化，为扩散语言模型的隐私审计提供了一种查询高效且理论有据的新方法。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive models, yet they may expose sensitive training data during denoising. Detecting such usage is challenging because dLLMs lack the efficient one-pass probability decomposition of causal architectures. Existing methods rely on random masking to obtain tractable token-wise detection signals under limited query budgets, but fail to control dependencies among masked tokens. We demonstrate that this token-wise approximation introduces a non-negative structural estimation error, which is theoretically characterized by the cumulative conditional mutual information (CMI) among masked tokens and can obscure subtle memorization signals. This insight suggests that reliable detection requires masked token sets with weak internal dependency. To avoid the prohibitive cost of directly estimating CMI over token combinations, we propose \textit{Independent Token Sampling} (ITS), a query-efficient framework that uses an attention-derived pairwise dependency proxy to approximate the CMI-aware selection criterion. ITS further incorporates a diversity-promoting strategy to improve token coverage across sampling rounds, yielding aggregated token-wise signals that are less affected by dependency-induced approximation error. Experiments on multiple datasets show that ITS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different models and datasets, achieving an AUC improvement of 0.18 on the ArXiv dataset while maintaining strong performance under limited query budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Chrisqcwx/DLLM-MIA .

</details>


### [241] [GRRR: The Geometry of Reshaping, Rotation, and Routing in Decoder LLM post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22146)
*Jianing Qi,Hao Tang,Zhigang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过SVD框架分析LLM后训练权重变化，发现对角分量（重塑奇异值）通常可剥离且保留大部分性能提升，说明后训练增益主要来自路径重组而非奇异值改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究后训练（SFT与RL）相对预训练权重究竟改变了什么，以理解后训练提升的本质来源。

Method: 在12条后训练链上，将每个权重更新表示在预训练矩阵的SVD框架中，分解为对角、非对角与零空间三个几何分量。

Result: 在数学评测集上，移除对角分量通常仍能保留后训练的大部分收益。

Conclusion: 后训练增益主要来自对预训练路径的重配置与扩展，而非显著改变预训练模型的奇异值。

Abstract: We study how post-training changes the weights of Large Language Models (LLMs) relative to their pretrained weights. Across 12 post-training chains with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), we express each weight update in the pretrained matrix's singular value decomposition (SVD) frame. This decomposition separates the changes of three geometrically distinct components: diagonal values, which reshapes singular values; off-diagonal values, which rotates the coupling between pretrained input and output directions; and null-space values, which routes outside the matrix's original nonzero SVD core. On a math evaluation suite, we find that removing the diagonal component usually preserves most of the gains from post-training. These results suggest that post-training gains are carried primarily by reconfiguring and extending pretrained pathways rather than by substantially changing singular values of pre-trained models.

</details>


### [242] [SafeTune: A Unified Faithful Library for Auditing and Repairing Safety Drift in Fine-Tuned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22153)
*Pratinav Seth,Saisab Sadhu,Anshul Kaushal,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SafeTune 是一个开源库，统一了微调大语言模型安全漂移问题的四类干预范式，并提供共享的可解释性、评估与部署工具，支持配置化工作流与模块化扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对微调大语言模型（LLMs）安全漂移问题的方法分散在互不兼容的实现、生命周期阶段和评估协议中，难以采用与比较。

Method: 提出 SafeTune 库，统一四类干预范式：事后权重恢复、安全约束微调、基于梯度的遗忘、推理时引导；同时提供共享的可解释性、评估和部署工具。采用一致的配置驱动工作流，保留各范式所需的输入与干预点，并通过模块化注册机制支持新方法、基准、评判器、模型和微调领域的扩展。

Result: 通过受控对比实验以及金融和医疗部署案例研究验证 SafeTune，展示其刻画安全漂移、在常见拒答行为和能力评估上评估可行干预，并支持校准或分层缓解。

Conclusion: SafeTune 为 LLM 安全漂移的干预与评估提供了统一、可扩展的工具平台，便于方法的采用与比较。

Abstract: Methods for addressing safety drift in fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) are scattered across incompatible implementations, lifecycle stages, and evaluation protocols, making them difficult to adopt and compare. We introduce SafeTune, a source-available library that unifies four intervention paradigms: post-hoc weight recovery, safety-constrained fine-tuning, gradient-based unlearning, and inference-time steering, alongside shared interpretability, evaluation, and deployment utilities. SafeTune provides a consistent configuration-driven workflow while preserving the distinct inputs and intervention points each paradigm requires. Its modular registry supports new methods, benchmarks, judges, models, and fine-tuning domains without redesigning the surrounding pipeline. We demonstrate SafeTune through controlled comparisons and finance and medical deployment case studies, showing how it characterizes safety drift, evaluates feasible interventions on common refusal-behavior and capability evaluations, and supports calibrated or layered mitigation.

</details>


### [243] [A Comparative Framework for Evaluating Foundation Models on Tabular Data: A Case Study in Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22154)
*Majid Lotfian Delouee,Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld,Martijn C. Schut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个比较评估框架，用六个临床相关维度对表格基础模型评分排序，并用两个医疗用例演示不同临床情境下排序不同，同时给出45个TFM的分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据是临床实践中最常见的格式（实验室结果、用药记录、诊断编码、人口统计）。表格基础模型（TFM）数量与种类激增，实践者难以判断给定任务该选哪个模型、为什么。现有综述只罗列这些模型能做什么，没有提供结构化方法来对照真实应用的具体需求进行比较。

Method: 提出一个比较评估框架，从六个临床意义维度对表格基础模型进行评分和排序：对新数据集的泛化能力、保护患者隐私的效果、达到良好表现所需的数据量、随数据集与特征空间增长的扩展性、对临床医生的可解释性、跨患者亚组的公平性。每个维度分解为可测量的子成分，子成分组可选地组合成补充性的复合分数（super-metrics），提供跨多维度同时诊断的视图。此外提供按底层架构组织的45个TFM分类体系。

Result: 将框架应用于两个医疗用例——缺铁筛查和心力衰竭预测，展示同一套指标在不同临床情境下会得出不同的模型排序。并给出45个表格基础模型的架构分类。

Conclusion: 该框架为临床医生和数据科学家提供了结构化的模型比较与选择依据，强调模型选择取决于具体临床情境中最重要的需求；TFM分类体系也可作为研究者与实践者的参考索引。

Abstract: Tabular data is the most common format in clinical practice, encompassing laboratory results, medication records, diagnostic codes, and patient demographics. As foundation models for tabular data have grown in number and variety, a practical question has become harder to answer: which model should a clinician or data scientist actually choose for a given task, and why? Existing surveys catalogue what these models can do, but they stop short of providing a structured way to compare them against the specific demands of a real application. We introduce \system{}, a comparative evaluation framework that scores and ranks tabular foundation models (TFMs) across six clinically meaningful dimensions: how well a model generalizes to new datasets, how effectively it protects patient privacy, how much data it needs to perform well, how it scales with growing datasets and feature spaces, how interpretable its predictions are to clinicians, and how fairly it performs across patient subgroups. Each dimension is broken down into measurable sub-components, and groups of sub-components can optionally be combined into supplementary compound scores, called super-metrics, that provide a diagnostic view of how a model performs across several dimensions simultaneously. To show how the framework works in practice, we apply it to two healthcare use cases, screening for iron deficiency and predicting heart failure, demonstrating how the same set of metrics leads to different model rankings depending on what matters most in each clinical context. We also provide a taxonomy of 45 TFMs organized by their underlying architecture, which serves as a reference for researchers and practitioners looking to navigate this rapidly expanding field.

</details>


### [244] [From Latent Biomarkers to Clinical Rules: Embedding-Guided Rule Mining and Attribution-Based Translation for Interpretable Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22155)
*Majid Lotfian Delouee,Hamed Ayoobi,Sjors G. J. G. In 't Veld,Martijn C. Schut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个四步流程，在FT-Transformer的潜空间中挖掘决策规则，并将其翻译回可测量的临床特征，以兼顾预测准确性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策支持工具需要准确预测与可理解解释并存。基于规则模型透明，但直接从原始临床测量中导出规则可能遗漏多变量交互产生的模式。

Method: 四步流程：将一致区分患者群体的嵌入维度视为潜生物标志物；用小决策树挖掘规则；通过梯度输入显著性和CLS注意力归因翻译所选规则；在六个公开临床与人群健康数据集、四个嵌入维度上评估。

Result: 翻译后的规则在六个数据集中的五个优于原始特征规则，平均AUROC提升0.04至0.23。在心脏病数据集上，嵌入空间规则达0.98 AUROC，但翻译后降至0.72，表明高性能潜规则难以用简单原始特征条件表示。

Conclusion: 潜空间规则发现能揭示有预测性的模式，并可翻译为临床可测量特征供临床医生评估，但翻译过程可能造成性能损失。

Abstract: Clinical decision support tools are most useful when accurate predictions are accompanied by understandable explanations. Rule-based models provide transparency, but rules derived directly from raw clinical measurements may miss patterns arising from interactions between multiple variables. We present a four-step pipeline that mines decision rules in the latent space of an FT-Transformer and translates them back into measurable clinical features. Embedding dimensions that consistently separate patient groups are treated as latent biomarkers, rules are mined using small decision trees, and selected rules are translated using gradient-input saliency and CLS attention attribution. We evaluate the framework on six public clinical and population health datasets at four embedding dimensions. Translated rules outperformed raw-feature rules in five of six datasets, with mean AUROC gains ranging from 0.04 to 0.23. On the heart disease dataset, embedding-space rules reached 0.98 AUROC, but translation reduced this to 0.72, showing that high-performing latent rules cannot always be represented by simple raw-feature conditions. These results show that latent-space rule discovery can uncover predictive patterns while translating them into clinically measurable features that can be evaluated by clinicians.

</details>


### [245] [The Limits of Speculation: Bounding Speculative Decoding in Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22156)
*Aidar Amankulov,Denis Mamatin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将MoE模型中的推测解码预算选择建模为离线随机最短路径问题，构建诊断性Oracle进行反事实仿真，发现被拒绝的候选在边际增量空间中形成严格线性边界，揭示局部最优由"边际成本与期望进度之比"的必要条件支配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型中的推测解码面临验证成本随输入依赖的专家加载而不稳定这一难题，缺乏对验证成本物理机制的深入理解，也缺少为自适应在线启发式设计提供理论依据的严格参考点。

Method: 将推测-预算选择形式化为在参考序列上的离线随机最短路径（SSP）问题，并构建一个利用反事实仿真来刻画MoE验证成本的诊断性Oracle；在Qwen3-Coder与EAGLE-3配对上，于边际增量空间（Delta Space）中分析Oracle的决策。

Result: 在Delta Space中，被拒绝的候选形成严格的线性边界，表明复杂的全局优化在局部受一个必要条件支配，即平衡边际成本与期望进度（ΔE[Cost]/ΔE[a]）。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了MoE推测解码验证成本的局部线性规律，为设计未来自适应在线启发式方法提供了严格的数学参考点。

Abstract: Speculative decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faces the problem of unstable verification cost caused by input-dependent expert loading. To study the physics of this process, we formulate speculation-budget selection as an offline Stochastic Shortest Path (SSP) problem over reference sequences and build a diagnostic Oracle that uses counterfactual simulation to account for MoE verification cost. A detailed analysis of the Oracle's decisions on the Qwen3-Coder and EAGLE-3 pairing, in the space of marginal deltas (Delta Space), shows that rejected candidates form a strict linear boundary. This result demonstrates that a complex global optimization is locally governed by a necessary condition balancing marginal cost against expected progress ($\frac{Δ\mathbb{E}[Cost]}{Δ\mathbb{E}[a]}$), providing a rigorous mathematical reference point for designing future adaptive online heuristics.

</details>


### [246] [PAGE: Partition-Aware Gated KV-Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22157)
*Pankaj Kumar,Subhankar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出PAGE，将KV缓存淘汰重新定义为“每个输入是否准入淘汰”的决策，用prefill注意力的一个无标签标量预测输入类别，从而在容量受限输入上避免灾难性精度崩塌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存淘汰方法通常只决定保留哪些token，而不判断是否应当淘汰，导致基准均值掩盖了一类输入：在这些输入上压缩会让准确率从99%骤降到0%。作者希望识别并保护这类“容量受限”输入，避免平均指标掩盖的安全隐患。

Method: 作者将淘汰重新表述为逐输入的准入决策，并发现输入可分为容量受限类（任何预算下淘汰都灾难性）和易稀释类（淘汰安全甚至有益）。PAGE使用一个从prefill注意力计算的无标签标量——top-k注意力头两两一致性的早晚期下降幅度——在解码前预测类别。下降大时启用基础淘汰器，下降小时保留完整缓存，无需训练和准确率标签。跨四种架构家族该指标一致地对输入按淘汰安全性排序，新家族可用约100个无标签输入进行阈值重校准。

Result: 作为保护措施，PAGE在容量受限区间将危害率从0.75降至0.026，降低29倍，覆盖四种淘汰器、四个模型和两个基准，把99%到0%的崩塌变为稳定的89%，且无需重训练淘汰器。门控在淘汰本已安全处保持惰性，受保护的容量受限类是少数可识别输入，因此收益是针对性安全提升而非平均收益。PAGE不是压缩器，实际压缩为1.8–3.4倍（均值2.9倍），远低于名义16倍预算，静态分配下batch 16时趋于1，且在同等内存下训练过的淘汰器更优。

Conclusion: PAGE是一种逐输入安全保护机制，通过无标签注意力信号在淘汰前识别容量受限输入，显著降低灾难性精度损失；但它并非高效压缩方案，实际压缩率有限，在匹配内存下训练型淘汰器仍具优势。

Abstract: KV-cache eviction methods decide which tokens to keep but not whether to evict at all, so a benchmark mean can hide a class of inputs on which compression drives accuracy from 99\% to 0\%. We reframe eviction as a per-input admission decision and show that inputs separate into a capacity-bound class, where eviction is catastrophic at every budget, and a dilution-prone class, where eviction is safe or beneficial. A single label-free scalar computed from prefill attention, the early-to-late drop in pairwise top-$k$ head agreement, predicts this class before any decoding. PAGE thresholds this drop: it applies any base evictor when the drop is large and retains the full cache otherwise, with no training and no accuracy labels. The drop orders inputs by eviction safety consistently across four architecture families, and a per-model unlabeled pilot of about 100 inputs recalibrates the threshold for a new family. Used as a safeguard, PAGE cuts the harm rate on the capacity-bound regime from 0.75 to 0.026, a 29 $\times$ reduction, across four evictors, four models, and two benchmarks, turning a 99\% to 0\% collapse into a flat 89\% without retraining the evictor. The gate is inert wherever eviction is already safe, and the capacity-bound class it protects is a small, identifiable minority of inputs, so the benefit is a targeted safety gain rather than an average one. PAGE is a per-input safeguard, not a compressor: realized compression is $1.8 - 3.4 \times$ (mean 2.9$\times$) against a nominal 16$\times$ budget and decays toward unity by batch 16 under static provisioning, and a trained evictor wins at matched memory.

</details>


### [247] [StepKV: Step-Aware KV Cache Compression for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22158)
